verdict: Both are almost the same. Same calories and fat, but pan mee soup has a little more protein.
why: Both are about 450 kcal per serving.
Fat is the same too, about 14 g each.
Pan mee soup has about 22 g protein, dry wantan mee 20 g. Only a small difference.
Soup usually makes you eat more slowly. Dry wantan mee is easier to add extra fried wantan or char siu to.
when_a: Dry wantan mee is okay for a regular lunch. Choose boiled wantan over fried.
when_b: Pan mee soup suits when you want something hot and filling. Watch out for the fried ikan bilis sprinkled on top.
tip: Ask for extra vegetables, choose boiled wantan, and cut down on fried ikan bilis or shallot oil on the noodles.

faq.q: Why isn't dry wantan mee higher in calories than the soup one?
faq.a: The dry sauce has oil, but pan mee has fried ikan bilis and thick noodles. In the end, the total calories are about the same.
Pan mee soup is slightly more filling for most people because of the soup and a bit more protein. But the difference is small.
